reason: I've already paid for a DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, so 'sends from your own Instagram' just sounds like the same risk with nicer wording. $147 a month with zero customer results published isn't something I can justify until I land the next client.
objection: It sends from my own account, and my last tool got that account action-blocked. Nobody has shown me results, and 7 of 100 seats taken tells me almost nobody has tried it. If my account gets flagged, I lose the account I earn my living from, and the payments are final after day 3.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from a named SDR or agency that has run it for 30+ days with no action blocks, ideally with a screenshot of their reply rate. A lower price or a month-to-month refund window would help too.
